text: ok and then help me understand how we can have a bunch of tests written that pass then somehow the blob cant be read in the actual app; thats a useless test as far as im concerned
resolution: Audited why RJMD tests passed while Compact_Car_001 failed in the production editor. Proven: TS v5 tests hand-built tiny buffers, Zig tests exercised a shared helper encoder, character cold-open used mocked FS, and none exercised the generic prop host writer or a real process restart. Found and fixed the concrete save gate where native success plus parseDocBlob(null) could still advance parts.json/report success; unreadable native output now rolls back/refuses. Added structured first-failure diagnostics exposed by Seat package and focused regression tests (21/21 pass). Exact existing artifact rejection remains intentionally unknown until reopened through the supported diagnostic path; backup untouched.
